findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed the following are not smooth, easily cleanable surfaces: 

(1) Observed the newly installed coolers still have the protective coating (which is starting to peel off). The PIC began the process of removing the protective coating during the inspection. The coating must be completely removed to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface. 

(2) Observed there are several small holes in the wall surrounding the triple sink. The holes must be filled (ex. caulking) to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

Ensure that all surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
No signed reporting agreements available for employees present. Inspector emailed document to PIC. Print, review with staff, and keep signed copies available for review during health inspections. Inspector will follow up at next scheduled event: 5/18/2023.
Ref. 2-103.11 (O) [Pf]

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
No vomit/diarrhea clean up policy on file. Inspector emailed document to PIC. Print and keep available for reference. Inspector will follow up at next scheduled event: 5/18/2023.
Ref. 2-501.11 [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Multiple employees observed to wash hands then turn faucet off without the use of a barrier (paper towel). Provided education and discussed with PIC. Review with all staff. Ref. 2-301.12 [P]

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Employees without food handler certificates. Two employees need to complete the course and provide certificates. A third employee has completed the training but does not have a certificate (is on file at the school she works at). Ensure all employees have food handler certificates on file by the next routine inspection.
Ref. 410 ILCS 625 Sec. 3.07 [C]
